title: Login panel
responsibility: Shows sign-in availability, a Google sign-in button or the pending email-confirmation step.

inputs.name: LoginPanel.reason
inputs.description: Optional introductory text, defaulting to guidance to sign in with Google to open invited projects. Used only in the ordinary sign-in view.

outputs.name: LoginPanel
outputs.description: Shows checking/error state before session status, configuration guidance when disabled, or email confirmation when pending. Otherwise renders a Google button only when a configured client ID, no actor, no pending proof and a holder are available. Obtains a fresh challenge and ignores stale challenge completion; challenge/button failures and session errors become alerts.
